Room ochilgach tizim kod va ulashish hav: Once the room is open, the system gives you a code and a share link. It may not look like a setting, but it is the most practical part of the create flow for gathering the group quickly.

Hostga yengil format kerak bo'lsa: If the host wants a light format
Murakkab role assignment yoki tun fazala: There is no complex role assignment or night phase, so even first-time hosts can manage it easily.
Mafia yashirin rollar, kuzatuv va jamoav: Mafia is a classic social game built on hidden roles, observation, and shared suspicion. Everyone talks during the day, while role holders make secret choices at night. Who you trust and which config you choose changes the entire tempo.
Mafia kuzatish, yolg'onni ushlash va oda: Mafia is a great format for groups that enjoy observing, catching lies, and analyzing how people speak.
Bir xil gapni ikki xil rol butunlay bosh: The same sentence can mean something completely different depending on the role saying it. How people interpret the night's events during the day often decides the winner.
Role composition oldindan ko'rinadi: maf: The role composition is visible in advance: you know the mafia count and whether the sheriff and doctor are included. That lets you fine-tune the balance for your group before opening the room.
Room ichidagi har bir o'yinchi yashirin: Each player in the room receives a hidden role. This stage defines the game's balance and starts play before anyone knows who is who.
Mafia nishon tanlaydi, komisar tekshirad: The mafia chooses a target, the sheriff checks or shoots, and the doctor tries to save someone. This phase creates hidden information and tension.
Tun natijasidan keyin hamma o'z versiyas: After the night results, everyone shares their version of the story. This is where observation, psychology, and misdirection do their work.
Jamoa shubhali odamni chiqaradi. Mafia t: The group removes the most suspicious person. The mafia wins if it reaches parity with the living townspeople; otherwise, the city side wins.
Davra kattaligi role balansiga va o'yin: The size of the group affects role balance and game length. As more people join, the discussion gets richer, but the session may also run longer.
Bu parametr o'yinning keskinligini belgi: This parameter defines the tension of the game. Less mafia creates more careful deduction, while more mafia increases the risk for the town side.
Komisar o'yinga tekshiruv va yo'naltiril: The sheriff adds investigation and directed suspicion. In newer groups, this role helps keep discussion organized.
Doktor tun fazasiga qarshi balans beradi: The doctor balances the night phase. If you do not want the session to become too harsh, turning the doctor on is useful.
Create sahifada qolgan oddiy fuqarolar s: The number of remaining regular citizens is calculated automatically on the create page. This helps prevent an invalid setup.
Agar jamoa mimika, gap uslubi va nozik t: If your group likes reading facial expressions, speech patterns, and subtle details, Mafia works especially well.
Bunkerga qaraganda ko'proq raund hissi b: Compared with Bunker, this game feels more round-based, so it suits groups that want to go deeper into a single game.
